note:
Mihara: Bonding Chain — MG/Fire. Board: 1.034 HOT on 2 graded comps (0.99 / 1.08). Two stack currencies are modeled as STEADY-STATE THROUGHPUT rather than as live counters, because the engine has no stack-currency primitive. Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/mihara-bonding-chain.test.ts (13 tests, groups M1-M5).
RESTRAINT CHAINS: charged to 10 at battle start and refilled to 10 at each Full-Burst end after her own burst; the S1 'specific timing' attack then dumps all of them, one 50.06% hit per chain. Modeled as a 500.6% (10 x 50.06) flatDamage dump on a passive at battle start and again on fullBurstEnd — she is the team's Burst III, so Full-Burst end coincides with her burst end.
ENSNARING CHAINS: a sustained-damage DoT capped at 20 stacks, fed by the Restraint hits and by S2's +1 per 40 normals during Full Burst. Her burst CANCELS Ensnaring to 0; it rebuilds +10 from the Restraint dump at the following FB end and +1 per 40 normals during FB windows, reaching the cap just before her next burst — a time-weighted average of ~12 stacks between bursts. Shipped as a permanent 301.0%/s DoT (12 x 25.08) ⚑ CALIBRATED: the 12-stack rebuild average is the one fitted number in this file, and it sits inside the kit-derived 10-12 window.
BURST — the DECOMPOSITION is the subtle part. Dragging Chain mirrors the 20 Ensnaring stacks for 10s, i.e. 1001%/s (20 x 50.05), and then cancels Ensnaring. Because the burst REPLACES Ensnaring rather than stacking with it, the burst block ships only the DELTA over the permanent baseline: 700.0%/s (1001 - 301) for 10s. During a burst window the total DoT output is therefore the correct 1001%/s with no double-count — the naive '1001 on top of the baseline' would over-count by roughly 195M. She reliably re-reaches ~20 stacks by the time she bursts, which is what makes the decomposition valid. The baseline and the delta are ONE calibration: move either and the burst window stops summing to 1001.
DoTs correctly inherit S2's stageEnter-3 sustainedDamagePct +59.98% / 10s through the Damage-Up bucket.
Her burst damage is a dot, and its kit clause is NOT one of the burst-amp literals, so the 'burstDesc is authorable on flatDamage only' engine gap is MOOT for her — there is nothing to tag and no eligibility claim to make.
NOT MODELED, by disposition: S2's 'when the skill user is incapacitated → Ensnaring +20' (defensive; the boss deals no damage) and 'when an enemy is neutralized → Restraint +1' (the boss never dies). S2's 40-normals-in-Full-Burst Ensnaring generation is not a discrete block but is FOLDED into the 12-stack average above — deliberately, not skipped.
In a multi-B3 comp the S1 fullBurstEnd dump can over-fire, since the kit's 'if this unit has just used her Burst Skill' gate is only exact when she is the sole B3. Benign on the graded comps; recorded as a kit-status finding rather than pinned as correct.

skill2: Activates when the skill user is incapacitated. Affects targets in the Ensnaring Chains state.
Activates when an enemy is neutralized while in the Ensnaring Chains state. Affects self.
